function Hero() return Scene.FindEntityByName('Hero') end
function HeroScript() return Hero():GetScript() end
function Game() return Scene.FindEntityByName('Game'):GetScript() end
function Shuttle() return Scene.FindEntityByName('Shuttle') end
function Near(a, b, tolerance) return math.abs(a - b) <= (tolerance or 1e-3) end
function Bone(name) return (Hero():GetBoneTransform(name)) end
-- How high a bone is above the ground right under it, and that ground's name.
function Clearance(bone)
	local p = Bone(bone)
	local hit = Physics.Raycast(p + Vec3(0, 0.6, 0), Vec3(0, -1, 0), 2, Hero())
	assert(hit, bone .. ' has no ground under it')
	return p.y - hit.Point.y, hit.Entity.Name
end
-- The lower foot's clearance (the foot standing on the ground); neither foot may sink into the ground.
function Stance()
	local l, lg = Clearance('LeftFoot')
	local r, rg = Clearance('RightFoot')
	assert(l > -0.02 and r > -0.02, string.format('a foot sank into the ground: %.3f %.3f', l, r))
	if l < r then return l, lg end
	return r, rg
end
-- Where the cape's tips (their average) and the ponytail's tip are relative to the chest and the head. The course
-- runs along +Z, so behind the hero is -Z.
function Cape() return (Bone('CapeLTip') + Bone('CapeRTip')) * 0.5 - Bone('Chest') end
function Hair() return Bone('HairTip') - Bone('Head') end
-- The run's gait and the colliders on the legs swing the cape back and forth, so it is checked on average.
Samples = {}
function Sample() Samples[#Samples + 1] = { Cape = Cape(), Hair = Hair() }; return #Samples end
function Average(part)
	local sum = Vec3(0, 0, 0)
	for _, sample in ipairs(Samples) do sum = sum + sample[part] end
	return sum * (1 / #Samples)
end
function V(v) return string.format('(%.3f, %.3f, %.3f)', v.x, v.y, v.z) end
function State()
	local h, g = Hero(), Game()
	return string.format('%s at %s, velocity %s, coins %d, deaths %d, checkpoint %s', h:GetAnimationState(), V(h.WorldPosition), V(h:GetLinearVelocity()), g.Coins, g.Deaths, g.Checkpoint)
end
-- The cape and ponytail at rest, standing still (measured once the hero has settled at the start).
RestCape, RestHair = nil, nil
return 'ok'

local h, g = Hero(), Game()
local names = {}
for _, action in ipairs(Input.GetActions()) do names[#names + 1] = action.Name end
assert(table.concat(names, ',') == 'MoveX,MoveY,Jump,Run', table.concat(names, ','))
assert(g.Coins == 0 and g.CoinCount == 4 and g.Deaths == 0 and g.Checkpoint == 'Start' and not g.Won, 'game ' .. State())
assert(h:IsGrounded() and h:GetAnimationState() == 'Locomotion' and HeroScript().Speed == 0, State())
-- Foot placement keeps both ankles at their animated height (0.055 m) above the start pad.
for _, foot in ipairs({ 'LeftFoot', 'RightFoot' }) do
	local clearance, ground = Clearance(foot)
	assert(Near(clearance, 0.055, 0.01) and ground == 'StartPad', string.format('%s %.3f above %s', foot, clearance, ground))
end
-- The cape hangs down the back, the ponytail behind the head.
RestCape, RestHair = Cape(), Hair()
assert(RestCape.y < -0.3 and RestCape.z < -0.1 and math.abs(RestCape.x) < 0.02, 'cape ' .. V(RestCape))
assert(RestHair.z < -0.1, 'hair ' .. V(RestHair))
assert(Scene.FindEntityByName('Camera').WorldPosition.z < h.WorldPosition.z - 5, 'the camera is not behind the hero')
return 'cape ' .. V(RestCape) .. ' hair ' .. V(RestHair)

local h = Hero()
local v = h:GetLinearVelocity()
-- The Walk clip's root motion moves the character at its own 1.5 m/s.
assert(h:GetAnimationState() == 'Locomotion' and Near(v.z, 1.5, 0.01) and Near(v.x, 0, 1e-3), State())
local stance, ground = Stance()
assert(stance < 0.1 and ground == 'StartPad', string.format('stance foot %.3f above %s', stance, ground))
return State()

assert(hair.z < RestHair.z - 0.03 and hair.y > RestHair.y + 0.03, 'hair ' .. V(hair) .. ' at rest ' .. V(RestHair))

local cape = Average('Cape')

local h = Hero()
local offset = h.WorldPosition.z - Shuttle().WorldPosition.z
assert(Shuttle():GetScript().State == 'End' and Near(offset, RideOffset, 0.03) and h:IsGrounded(), string.format('%.3f: %s', offset, State()))

local h, g = Hero(), Game()
local p = h.WorldPosition
assert(p.z > 29.5 and p.z < 31.5 and p.y > 0.1 and p.y < 0.5 and h:IsGrounded() and HeroScript().Speed == 0, State())
assert(g.Coins == 4, State())
-- Foot placement keeps both ankles at their animated height above the slope and turns the feet to it (the ramp
-- tilts 11.3 degrees).
local tilts = {}
for _, foot in ipairs({ 'LeftFoot', 'RightFoot' }) do
	local position, rotation = Hero():GetBoneTransform(foot)
	local hit = Physics.Raycast(position + Vec3(0, 0.6, 0), Vec3(0, -1, 0), 2, h)
	assert(hit and hit.Entity.Name == 'Ramp', foot .. ' is not over the ramp')
	assert(Near(position.y - hit.Point.y, 0.055, 0.01), string.format('%s %.3f above the ramp', foot, position.y - hit.Point.y))
	local up = rotation * Vec3(0, 1, 0)
	local tilt = math.deg(math.acos(math.min(1, up:Dot(Vec3(0, 1, 0)))))
	assert(up:Dot(hit.Normal) > math.cos(math.rad(1)) and tilt > 10, string.format('%s tilts %.1f degrees, not along the ramp', foot, tilt))
	tilts[#tilts + 1] = string.format('%.1f', tilt)
end
-- Off the windy stretch the wind stops.
assert(h:GetComponent('SpringBone').Wind[1] == 0, 'the wind kept blowing')
return 'feet tilt ' .. table.concat(tilts, ' ') .. ' degrees'
